name: Leninism
summary: Leninism is Vladimir Lenin's adaptation of Marxism: a disciplined vanguard party of committed revolutionaries leads the working class to overthrow the capitalist state and establish a dictatorship of the proletariat through soviets. It adds a theory of imperialism as the monopoly stage of capitalism, support for national self-determination, and a strict secular line towards religion, with the state expected eventually to wither away.
scope: Lenin's own thought and practice from What Is To Be Done? (1902) to his death in 1924, drawing on The State and Revolution, Imperialism and his writings on nations and religion, including war communism and the NEP. It excludes Stalin's later codification (see marxism-leninism), Trotskyism and Maoism.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Lenin saw capitalist markets as anarchic and monopoly-ridden, and treated the NEP market as a temporary retreat.

public-ownership.rationale: Lenin envisaged the whole economy run as a single state syndicate, and war communism nationalized industry.

unions-good.rationale: Unions are useful schools of struggle, but Lenin held that on their own they yield only trade-union, not socialist, consciousness.

property-fundamental.rationale: Private ownership of the means of production is the root of exploitation and is to be abolished.

cut-welfare.rationale: Cutting provision for workers contradicts the aims of a workers' state; Lenin attacked bourgeois reformism, not welfare itself.

worker-ownership.rationale: Lenin wanted the means of production owned by the whole workers' state, not by each workforce, and opposed syndicalism.

state-harmful.rationale: The state is an instrument of class oppression that will wither away, but it is needed in the transition, so adherents do not call it simply unnecessary.

empower-police-military.rationale: Lenin wanted the standing army and police replaced by the armed people, though he accepted force against exploiters.

more-religion-public.rationale: The party fights religion ideologically and the state should have no connection with it.

separate-church-state.rationale: Lenin demanded that religion be a private matter in relation to the state, with no funding for churches.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Lenin rejected cultural-national autonomy and saw national culture as divided by class.

gradual-change.rationale: Lenin held that the bourgeois state must be smashed by revolution, not reformed.

free-trade.rationale: Lenin saw free competition giving way to monopoly and capital export as the root of imperialism.

nation-first.rationale: Proletarian internationalism puts class solidarity above national interest.

limit-growth.rationale: Lenin's communism rests on a great growth of productive forces and abundance.

revolution-justified.rationale: Lenin held that capitalism can be overthrown only by revolution.

experts-over-public.rationale: Lenin argued that administration is simple enough for any literate worker and that experts should serve the workers.

central-planning.rationale: Lenin's programme looked to a planned economy, with Gosplan under Lenin and war communism, though the NEP loosened it.

socialized-markets.rationale: The NEP allowed markets under state control, but Lenin saw this as a temporary retreat and the question is split among adherents.

land-value-tax.rationale: Not a Leninist measure; Lenin sought public ownership of land instead.

basic-income.rationale: In the first phase of communism reward follows labour, so unconditional income is rejected.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Under war communism and the plan the state directs production and investment.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Lenin wanted socialized production, not a wide spread of small owners.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Wage slavery is to end in the higher phase of communism, though the first phase keeps pay by labour.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Lenin wanted banks nationalized and merged into a single state apparatus, and criticized the rule of finance capital.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Lenin rejected cooperation between classes in favour of class struggle.

one-party-rule.rationale: The party leads the dictatorship of the proletariat and the Bolsheviks banned rivals in 1921, though Lenin did not call one-party rule inherent.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Lenin's democratic revolution aimed to overthrow the Tsarist monarchy.

democracy-best.rationale: Lenin called democracy only one stage on the road to communism and criticized bourgeois democracy.

workers-councils.rationale: Lenin held that soviets of workers should hold power instead of a parliament.

right-to-secede.rationale: Lenin defined self-determination as the right of political separation into independent states.

natural-rulers.rationale: Lenin held that ordinary workers can administer the state, although he also gave a leading role to the vanguard.

political-violence-never.rationale: Lenin demanded armed force to suppress the resistance of the exploiters.

war-builds-character.rationale: Lenin condemned imperialist war, though he accepted revolutionary civil war.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Lenin saw religion as a product of oppression and wanted a secular state.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Lenin wanted a workers' state that holds the monopoly of force.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Lenin opposed national chauvinism and supported equality of nations within multinational states.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Class struggle is the central driver of history in the Marxist framework Lenin adopted.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Lenin aimed to end classes and move to distribution by need, though the first phase keeps inequality by labour.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Lenin opposed bourgeois individualism and capitalist profit-seeking.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Lenin built on industry and productive growth as the basis of communism.

restore-past-order.rationale: Lenin was a revolutionary aiming at a new order.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Lenin held that there can be no revolutionary movement without revolutionary theory.

direct-action.rationale: Lenin held that the final aim is armed uprising, but he urged using parliaments and unions tactically; adherents split on the balance.

means-match-ends.rationale: Lenin defended a dictatorship and coercion as means to a stateless society.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Lenin's communism required developed productive forces.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Lenin looked to the end of the division between mental and physical labour in the higher phase.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Lenin endorsed from each according to ability, to each according to needs for the higher phase.

production-for-use.rationale: Communism replaces production for profit with production for social needs.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Lenin took over Marx's view of wage slavery and capitalist exploitation.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Lenin held that the workers hold power and suppress exploiters through the transition until classes vanish.

collective-farming.rationale: Lenin favoured large-scale socialized agriculture and cooperatives, though he made concessions to the peasantry.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Imperialism, the monopoly stage of capitalism, brings violent rivalry among great powers.

taxation-theft.rationale: The state taxes to fund the common economy; Lenin saw property, not taxation, as exploitation.

harm-principle.rationale: Lenin held that the workers' state may restrict exploiters' rights as class measures.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Lenin gave rights by class and treated bourgeois rights as formal.

state-as-business.rationale: Lenin saw the state as an instrument of class rule, not a business serving customers.

positive-liberty.rationale: Lenin dismissed bourgeois freedom as formal and tied real freedom to material conditions.

organic-representation.rationale: Lenin wanted soviets of workers, not representation of family and corporate bodies.

total-state.rationale: The state is meant to wither away, though it directs the economy in the transition.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Lenin condemned imperialist division of the world among great powers.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Lenin's party rested on programme and discipline, not personal oaths.

bound-labor.rationale: Lenin opposed feudal and serf-like obligations.

single-common-good.rationale: Lenin held that class interests conflict under capitalism, so no single common good exists until classes disappear.

revive-national-language.rationale: Lenin stressed a common language for the home market while backing equal language rights.

rule-by-example.rationale: Lenin relied on organized party discipline and state power, not moral example.

national-self-determination.rationale: Lenin supported the right of nations to self-determination.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Lenin held to scientific socialism and opposed religion.

work-for-welfare.rationale: In the first phase reward follows labour: those who do not work do not eat.

class-collaboration.rationale: Lenin held that spontaneity and cooperation with the bourgeoisie subordinate workers.

dominated-front.rationale: Lenin sought alliance between the working class and oppressed colonial peoples against imperialist powers.

workers-nation.rationale: Lenin held that the workers should unite internationally and rejected national chauvinism.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Bolshevism stood for equal rights for women.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Lenin opposed national and racial oppression.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Lenin held that the state is an organ of one class's rule over another.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Lenin opposed forced assimilation, favouring equality of nations and languages.

proportional-representation.rationale: Lenin was critical of parliaments and favoured soviet delegation.

national-mission.rationale: Lenin saw the Russian revolution as a spark for world revolution.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Lenin held that parliamentary representatives serve the oppressing class and that officials should lose privileges.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Lenin defended the force of the revolutionary state.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Lenin wanted a state running the whole economy in transition.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Equal rights are a goal, but Lenin gave priority to class and denied rights to exploiters in transition.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Lenin tied the survival of the revolution to revolutions elsewhere; the doctrine of socialism in one country is Stalinist.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Lenin demanded separating school from church.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Lenin held that the dictatorship stays while enemies resist, but the encirclement thesis is Stalin's.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Legitimacy rests on class power and the vanguard, not on consent of all.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Lenin held that force is necessary against exploiters.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Lenin held that class struggle, not competition among individuals, drives history, and saw competition breeding monopoly.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Bolsheviks banned rival parties during the Civil War.

separated-powers.rationale: Lenin wanted a working, not parliamentary, body combining legislation and execution.

decide-locally.rationale: Lenin argued for democratic proletarian centralism uniting the communes, rejecting federalism.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Lenin saw bourgeois ideology as dominant but held socialist theory to be scientific knowledge, not just class interest.

vanguard-party.rationale: What Is To Be Done? argues workers left alone reach only trade-union consciousness, so a vanguard party must bring socialist consciousness.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Lenin treated strikes as a school for the workers, so legal limits fit poorly, though the party later disciplined unions under war communism.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Lenin traces poverty to capitalism and monopoly rather than population, as in his theory of imperialism.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Lenin's internationalism and support for equal nations hold that workers of all peoples share interests, so diversity is not a threat.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Lenin wanted officials elected and recallable at a workman's wage, not chosen by chance.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: The dictatorship of the proletariat is explicitly the suppression of the exploiters by force, free of bourgeois legal limits.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: War communism used requisitioning and fixed prices to feed cities and army during scarcity.

party-controls-media.rationale: Lenin's party led the soviet state and restricted the opposition press from late 1917, though in principle open to debate within the party.

party-commands-army.rationale: The vanguard party leads the state and the Red Army, with party commissars overseeing officers.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Lenin's account of the Commune says all public service should be done at workmen's wages, and The State and Revolution endorses it.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Democratic centralism binds members to carry out adopted decisions after free debate, as Leninism documents it.

head-commands-forces.rationale: The State and Revolution replaces the standing army with the armed people and makes officials elected and recallable, the opposite of one-man command.

clerical-rule.rationale: Lenin demanded the separation of church from state and treated religion as a private matter, so clergy holding political authority is rejected.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Lenin argued that Russia's defeat was the lesser evil and urged turning the imperialist war into a civil war.

recall-officials.rationale: The State and Revolution calls for all officials to be elected and subject to recall at any time.

people-in-arms.rationale: The State and Revolution calls for replacing the standing army with the armed people.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: What Is To Be Done? argues socialist consciousness is brought to workers by revolutionary intellectuals, so he does not see them as out of touch.

death-penalty.rationale: Leninist practice used the Cheka and the Red Terror to execute class enemies and opponents.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Lenin's Socialism and Religion demands a militantly secular, scientific education.

minority-language-support.rationale: Lenin demands full equality of languages and opposes any compulsory state language.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Socialism and Religion makes religion a private matter before the state, with no special exemptions from general laws.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Lenin backed self-determination but tied real freedom to ending capitalist and imperialist domination.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Lenin preferred soviets to a parliamentary body and the Bolsheviks dissolved the Constituent Assembly.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Banks are to be merged into one state syndicate under workers' control, not left independent of the state.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Lenin called Soviet Russia a workers' state with bureaucratic distortions, yet also said NEP Russia contained and needed state capitalism and was not yet socialist, so his answer is mixed.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Lenin held that annexation of a nation's territory without its free consent is an act of oppression, and he demanded the right to self-determination including secession.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Lenin demanded that the state be separated from the church and religion be a private matter, and the Soviet government nationalised church property and curbed the clergy.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Lenin defended the right of nations to secede and held that a socialist state should not keep a nation by force, though the Soviet government fought some secessionist governments in practice.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Lenin's secular materialism and attack on religion reject divine kingship, and he sought to abolish the tsarist autocracy.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Lenin's programme aimed to expropriate capitalists and impose heavy taxation on property, which is the opposite of a flat rate.

character-from-environment.rationale: Marxism holds that social being determines consciousness, and Lenin expected the habits of the old order to be remade by new conditions after revolution.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Lenin rejected balancing classes in government and called for rule by the working class through soviets alone.

leader-cult.rationale: Lenin opposed the personal glorification of leaders, and the cult of Lenin grew mainly after his death; adherents of his thought favoured party leadership over personality.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Lenin held that the dictatorship of the proletariat is itself a continuation of class struggle and that the old exploiters resist; the danger of bureaucratic restoration worried him late in life.

land-redistribution.rationale: The Decree on Land abolished landed property at once without compensation and gave the land to those who work it.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Lenin backed self-determination by the population concerned and opposed annexations and national chauvinism, so claiming land because co-nationals live there is rejected.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: Lenin called for religion to be a private matter and for full freedom of conscience, with no state compulsion in either direction.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Lenin put class unity and internationalism above ethnic kinship and opposed nationalist unions of peoples.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Historical materialism is the core of Marxism-Leninism; the phases of communism depend on the development of the productive forces.

ban-cartels.rationale: Lenin argued that monopolies grow out of capitalist competition and must be socialized, not broken up to restore competition, which he called a reactionary petty-bourgeois aim.

moral-incentives.rationale: Adherents are split: war communism and the subbotniks stressed duty, while the NEP and 'to each according to labour' restored material incentives.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: The Bolshevik revolution aimed to end rule by birth; abolition of titles and estates followed it, and his socialism rejects inherited class privilege.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Lenin condemned colonial rule as imperialist plunder, though he held that backward nations could be helped by socialist states.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Imperialism argues that monopoly capitalism is parasitic and decaying and heads toward revolution.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: Lenin held that imperialist super-profits bribe an upper stratum of the proletariat, the labour aristocracy, not that most workers in rich countries escape exploitation; the argument is in Imperialism ch. VIII, not the cited ch. VII.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: The State and Revolution treats bourgeois constitutional guarantees as class rule to be replaced by soviet power.

elective-rulers.rationale: State and Revolution calls for elected, recallable officials in place of hereditary or bureaucratic rulers.

minority-veto.rationale: Democratic centralism binds the minority to party decisions.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Lenin wanted the parliamentary state smashed and replaced by soviets, so he would not endorse parliamentary supremacy.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Lenin sought to abolish class society rather than rely on duties of the privileged.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: What Is To Be Done? demands full-time political commitment from revolutionaries.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Lenin holds that workers left alone fall under bourgeois ideology, which dominates the culture.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: The State and Revolution stresses coercion by armed bodies, though Lenin also saw bourgeois ideology at work.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Imperialism argues that finance capital extracts super-profits from colonies and dependent countries.

native-born-offices.rationale: Lenin opposes any national privilege and holds that all nations must have equal rights.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Lenin replaces the standing army with the armed people under proletarian control, not a guardian army.

office-by-exam.rationale: Lenin wanted officials elected, paid a workman's wage and recallable, not a separate examined bureaucracy, though he accepted using specialists under workers' control.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Lenin's State and Revolution praises the Commune principle that delegates are removable at any time and bound by their electors.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Lenin treated private finance and wage labour as what the workers' state must abolish; retirement provision is a social, state-organised function.

land-use-tenure.rationale: The Decree on Land abolished private ownership of land and gave use rights to those who work it.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Lenin condemned bourgeois parliaments as talking shops and wanted working bodies that legislate and execute, so parliamentary budget approval is not a Leninist principle.

single-official-language.rationale: Lenin opposed a compulsory state language and defended equal rights of nations and languages while favouring a voluntary common one.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Lenin backed anti-colonial and revolutionary movements against imperialist states, and the Bolsheviks funded and armed them.

corporate-influence.rationale: Imperialism treats finance capital as dominating states, so corporate power over government is central.

job-guarantee.rationale: The State and Revolution describes a society where all do the work of state and economy, with labour owed by all.

democratic-peace.rationale: Imperialism holds that capitalist states, democratic or not, are driven to war by finance capital.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Lenin treats law as class rule to be smashed, but also demands strict discipline under the workers' state.

non-intervention.rationale: Lenin backed national self-determination yet urged turning imperialist war into civil war; split but leaning against.

informal-organisation.rationale: What Is To Be Done? argues for a tight, disciplined vanguard party and against spontaneity and informal circles.

religious-nation.rationale: Lenin says religion is a private matter for the state, and the party is atheist; nation is not defined by faith.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: Lenin favoured a centralised state and shared resources for the whole economy, so regions keeping their revenue conflicts with it.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Lenin held that the socialist transformation abolishes private ownership of the means of production while workers keep their consumption goods.

defeat-communism.rationale: Lenin's whole programme was to build communism; the statement is the opposite of his position.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Lenin expected the workers' state to run services itself, though the NEP allowed private enterprise as a temporary retreat.

religion-illusion.rationale: Lenin's Socialism and Religion calls religion a kind of spiritual oppression rooted in social and economic oppression that will fade with it.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Lenin followed Marx in seeing capitalism as developing the productive forces and socialising labour, but he also called imperialism parasitic and moribund.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Lenin rejected small communal settlements for a centralised state and large-scale economy, supporting cooperatives only as one transitional form.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Lenin saw only two paths, capitalism and socialism leading to communism, and rejected third ways.

suppress-opposition.rationale: The dictatorship of the proletariat means crushing the resistance of the old exploiting classes, which in practice meant banning rival parties.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Religion is to be a private matter as far as the state is concerned, so the state has no business punishing blasphemy or false religion.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Imperialism analyses colonial rule as capitalist plunder and Lenin called for colonial peoples' self-determination.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Lenin rejected religious law as a basis of rule and opposed religious bodies' political role, so this religious ground for rebellion is foreign to him.

participatory-democracy.rationale: State and Revolution wants all working people to learn to administer the state through soviets, though under a vanguard party.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Lenin opposed national and sex oppression but put class first; whether the three must be tackled together is not something he stated.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Lenin insisted that politics is class struggle led by a revolutionary party, rejecting both centrist and above-class framings.

alienated-labor.rationale: Wage slavery and the separation of workers from the product of their labour are core Marxist themes Lenin takes over, though he rarely uses the term alienation.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Lenin treats religion as a private matter and politics as class-based, rejecting any divine source of authority.

social-market-economy.rationale: The NEP was a temporary retreat to markets under state control, not a goal; the aim was socialism, not a mixed capitalist economy.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Lenin wanted the standing army replaced by the armed people, not no force at all, since the proletarian state must defend itself.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Lenin was internationalist and sought revolution, not neutrality, though he used peace and compromise (Brest-Litovsk) tactically.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Lenin called for overthrowing the tsarist monarchy and a republic of soviets, so hereditary succession of state leaders has no place.

property-franchise.rationale: Soviet suffrage barred property owners and exploiters rather than favouring them; Lenin held that property-based rule is the core of bourgeois dictatorship.

domination-women-nature.rationale: Lenin backed women's equality but did not link it to the domination of nature, which is not a Leninist theme.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Lenin argued that bourgeois freedoms of press and assembly are illusory for workers because capital owns the presses and halls.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Lenin defined the dictatorship of the proletariat as power won and kept by force and unrestricted by any laws, in The Proletarian Revolution and the Renegade Kautsky.

racial-franchise.rationale: Lenin demanded full equality of nations and opposed any national or racial privilege in political rights.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Lenin wanted religion a private matter and the state fully secular, so legal marriage restrictions by religion are rejected.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Lenin opposed national and religious discrimination and anti-Jewish agitation as tools of reaction.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Lenin held that capital concentrated in monopolies and finance capital dominates political life, though his concern is class power rather than liberty as such.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Lenin held religion should be a private matter as far as the state is concerned, while the party itself propagates atheism; so the state should not promote it officially.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Lenin's socialism relies on organised state and soviet provision and sees charity as a bourgeois palliative that leaves class power intact.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Lenin's government legislated full legal equality of the sexes and equal marital rights after 1917, which ended male legal authority.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Split: Lenin backed the Komsomol and Pioneers as party schools for youth, but the national-service element is not part of his doctrine.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: The State and Revolution describes a first stage of communism in which each is paid according to labour and the parasitic income of owners ends.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Lenin holds that the old state must be smashed by force and defends revolutionary violence, so no pacifist bar on killing is accepted.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Split: Lenin honoured fallen revolutionaries, but his strictly secular line rejects sainthood.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Lenin's Socialism and Religion treats religion as a superstition and holds socialism rests on materialism, so a spiritual struggle is rejected.

culture-before-state.rationale: What Is To Be Done? and the 1917 seizure of power put the party's political struggle first, not cultural renewal.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Lenin's essay on self-determination demands equal rights for all nations and opposes any national privilege.

independent-unions.rationale: Lenin held that trade unions should act under party leadership as a school of communism, and the Bolsheviks subordinated them to the party and workers' state.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: The State and Revolution makes the armed working class, organised through soviets, the ruler of the transitional state, and treats this as the content of socialism.

second-chamber.rationale: The State and Revolution rejects bourgeois parliamentarism and calls for working bodies that both legislate and execute, so a separate upper house has no place.

municipal-property.rationale: Lenin wanted production owned by the whole workers' state and organised centrally, not by localities; he criticised syndicalist and decentralist ownership.

person-over-state.rationale: Lenin held that the individual and the state's interests are to be subordinated to the revolution and the proletariat, and the party may use any individual as a means to that end.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Socialism and Religion treats religion as spiritual oppression and wants politics based on materialism, not a spiritual nature.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Lenin called on workers to turn imperialist war into civil war and supported revolutionary and national-liberation wars, so he rejected defensive-only force.

arms-reduction.rationale: In his 1916 article On the 'Disarmament' Slogan, Lenin called disarmament a wrong demand under imperialism and said the proletariat must arm itself.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Lenin's 1917 peace decree promised an end to secret diplomacy, but the Bolshevik state and the party practised secrecy, so the answer is split.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Lenin urged revolutionary defeatism and fraternisation against the imperialist war, but backed wars of defence of a socialist state, so the answer is limited to wars between capitalist states.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Imperialism analyses the world economy as dominated by finance capital and supports the self-determination and liberation of colonies.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Lenin's The State and Revolution argues that the bourgeois state machine must be smashed rather than taken over.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Lenin held there was a definite path of party-led dictatorship of the proletariat and planning, rejecting open pluralism; the NEP was a tactical retreat.

sacred-nation.rationale: Lenin's Socialism and Religion treats religion as a form of spiritual oppression and rejects sacralised communities; the nation belongs to the bourgeois order.

internal-colonialism.rationale: Lenin's writing on nations and imperialism describes oppressor and oppressed nations and economic exploitation of backward regions.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Marxist-Leninists treat human nature as historically shaped by social conditions, not as a fixed ground of rights.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Lenin held that religion is an illusion and 'opium of the people' and treated all faiths as false, not as expressions of one truth.

farm-price-support.rationale: The Decree on Land put land in the hands of the peasants and the state, and Lenin's workers' state planned supply and prices; guaranteed prices are an inference from that.

workers-own-party.rationale: What Is To Be Done? and Lenin's practice call for a working-class party independent of bourgeois parties.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Lenin's government abolished legal inequality between men and women and he demanded women's full equality in law.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Lenin's state was planned and centrally administered, and would regulate harm directly; private tort suits would be a bourgeois-legal device.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: The state is a class instrument and customary hereditary authority has no place in the soviet system.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Lenin opposed Great-Russian chauvinism and argued for language equality, but the state also promoted Russian; adherents are split.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Lenin held that religion is a private matter as far as the state is concerned, so the state should favour no confession.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Lenin held that bourgeois democracy is a dictatorship of the capitalist class, so free elections alone do not make a government democratic.

women-suffrage.rationale: Soviet Russia gave women the vote and office in 1917, and Lenin's democracy is meant to draw in every working person.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: Lenin described religion as spiritual oppression of the toiling masses and argued the fight against it belongs to the class struggle, though he did not single out women.

homestead-ownership.rationale: The Decree on Land abolishes private ownership of land and nationalises it, which rejects first-claim ownership.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Socialism and Religion calls religion a kind of spiritual booze and opposes religious doctrine as obscurantism.

defend-planned-state.rationale: Lenin defended the Soviet workers' state against capitalist restoration and intervention even while acknowledging bureaucratic distortions.

indirect-election.rationale: The soviet system builds higher bodies from delegates of lower councils, which Lenin favoured as against bourgeois parliaments.

national-church-status.rationale: Lenin demands the state be separate from religion and rejects any privileged church.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: Lenin backed regional autonomy for nationalities within a unified state alongside the right to self-determination.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: Lenin made the vanguard party the central instrument of revolution, and the Commune model he praised gave power to recallable delegates, not to a leader bypassing parties.

no-denominational-politics.rationale: Lenin held that religion should be a private matter as far as the state is concerned and that church and state be separated.

national-resource-control.rationale: The Decree on Land and later nationalisations placed natural resources under state control, and Lenin's theory of imperialism opposes foreign capital's control of colonies.

distribution-by-process.rationale: Lenin's Decree on Land confiscated estates without compensation, treating the property pattern as unjust whatever its history.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: Lenin built on Marx's view that value comes from labour and that profit is unpaid surplus labour, as his analysis of capitalism in Imperialism assumes.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Lenin held that workers have no stake in their own ruling class's war and urged revolutionary defeatism, so national loyalty and worker interests part ways.

material-over-identity.rationale: He ranked class above all but also backed national self-determination and attacked narrow economism, so adherents and texts do not give a clear answer.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: Under the NEP Lenin defended a market economy within a state held by the communist party as 'state capitalism' on the road to socialism.

missingStatements.text: The working class will not reach revolutionary politics on its own; it needs a disciplined party of committed revolutionaries to lead it.
missingStatements.rationale: What Is To Be Done? argues that workers left to themselves develop only trade-union consciousness, so socialist consciousness must be brought from outside by a vanguard.

notes: Adherents differ on whether one-party rule and the ban on factions were wartime necessities or part of the doctrine; this profile follows Lenin's own statements and the 1921 practice. Answers on social issues Lenin did not address are low confidence.
